title: Refuse a prior verdict after an earlier label on its line
why: A brief that relays a report, such as `Done: FAIL, round 1 of 3` or `Prior review: verdict: FAIL`, passes the blind-brief guard and anchors the reviewer (lane verdict-format-line, 07:20 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: refuse cases for those lines are red first, then green, in the reviewer-brief-blind family of hooks/test_guard.py; note verdict-label-prefix-passes is deleted. Follow-up PR after #1968, in lane verdict-format-line (coordinator, 07:20 CST Nov 8; items 386 and 410 a).
